ctx.x: Who was some of the other men in the bands when you went to play in the district? Some of them bands?

Well, when I went up there, Joe Oliver, Joe Oliver, let's see. You gotta remember now. I know T.O. was out there. T.O., Louie. T.O., Louie and Rocky. Them, them were the places we would go. Do they have little short bands or big orchestras? Well, they run into five piece bands. Back to Almas Avenue, how old were you when you moved away from there? Mm-hm, I didn't sit around there. I don't remember that. It was good.
Where did you move to after that?
